Sam (Sales): Quick heads-up — customer wants to run an EdgeAnalytics POC. They asked for a vendor security review (SIG/CAIQ), SOC2 evidence and a signed DPA. Can we turn around answers by EOD Friday? cc @Maria (Eng Sec) @Ajay (Sec Eng) :eyes:
Maria (Eng Sec): On it. Ajay, can you own the SIG/CAIQ mapping? I’ll loop in Legal for the DPA. Need vendor contact + architecture / data flow so we can triage risk.
Ajay (Sec Eng): I can run the CAIQ. Initial checklist I need from vendor/customer:
```
- Filled SIG/CAIQ (latest template)
- SOC2 Type II report + auditor contact
- Data flow diagram (where PHI/PII lands)
- KMS/CMEK support details
- Secrets/credential storage (Vault/HSM)
- Subprocessors list + locations
- Pen-test dates / vuln disclosure process
- Network allowlist CIDRs and TLS cert info
```
Also: any timeboxed deadline?
Sarah (Product): Integration uses an API key flow; tokens are kept in HashiVault. Traffic routes to vendor in eu-west1. Vendor claims CMEK available for buckets.
devsec-bot: Automated scan result: public-facing endpoints detected on `vendor.test.edgeanalytics.com` ports 8080, 8443 — categorized MEDIUM. Full scan: https://scans.internal/edge-1782 (internal).
Lee (Procurement): FYI procurement/contract side — we'll need vendor to accept our Vendor Addendum and provide proof of insurance. If they want custom terms, expect a few rounds of redlines.
Sam (Sales): Vendor contact is Anna (anna@edgeanalytics.com). Anna said they can fill SIG but asked for our CAIQ template + example DPA redlines. Customer deadline is Friday COB — they're pushing the timeline.
Ajay (Sec Eng): Please drop our CAIQ template in the thread (or point to last filled copy). I’ll also need their network diagram and TLS chain. If CMEK isn't available we need to flag that as a blocker and discuss token masking / gateway options.
Maria (Eng Sec): I’ll handle Legal loop and draft the agenda. Ajay — can you take the CAIQ review? I’ll intro Anna and schedule a 30m sync for Thu 10am PT. @Sam please confirm vendor availability.
Sam (Sales): Confirmed — invite sent to Anna for Thu 10am PT. Anna also requested our minimal encryption requirements doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/vendor-encryption-minimums (internal).
Anna (EdgeAnalytics): Thanks — we’ll fill out the SIG by EOD Wed. Quick notes: we run in GCP (eu-west1), use CMEK for GCS, SOC2 Type II report in progress (expected final 2025-05), pen test last run 2025-01. Data flow (simple): `client -> api.edgeanalytics.com -> processing -> GCS (eu-west1)`. Happy to provide diagrams and a contact for our SOC auditor.
Ajay (Sec Eng): Perfect — once we have the filled CAIQ and SOC2 artifact I’ll run a light telemetry/config check and share any findings. If anything blocks the POC (CMEK missing, public endpoints, unacceptable subprocessors) we’ll escalate in the sync.
Maria (Eng Sec): :thumbsup: Agenda for Thu: CAIQ review, SOC2 highlights, network allowlist, DPA redlines, next steps. I’ll bring suggested acceptance criteria.
Sam (Sales): I'll push Anna for the CAIQ by Wed EOD and forward any docs into this thread.
Anna (EdgeAnalytics): Sending CAIQ link + diagrams into the invite — will also attach SOC2 draft and cert of insurance before the sync. See you Thu.
Ajay (Sec Eng): Thanks — I’ll prepare a short checklist to run during the call so we can get an immediate risk call (green/amber/red) by end of day.
Maria (Eng Sec): Great. If any of you see a blocker before Thu, flag it here and tag @Maria (Eng Sec).
